item.title: Re: Auto-pilot
item.content:encoded:
Hmm. I had pictured the crash resulting not from an autopilot being turned permanently off but permanently on — that it would somehow take control of the plane completely, and since it couldn't be turned off, there'd be little the pilot(s) could do. Now that I write it out, though, that's… not nearly as plausible as I thought. Oops.

'Scuse me while I go do a little research. Gotta figure out how to phrase "747 hydraulics" for both maximum reader-recognizability and maximum immediate horror. Thanks! :)

item.title: Auto-pilot
item.content:encoded: Great writing here! The only thing that stands out to me is that disabling (or even destroying) the autopilot likely wouldn't cause a crash. There is always someone in the cockpit to take control. Perhaps change it to "Boeing 747 Hydraulics" or some other key system?

item.title: Author's Note
